method unique_digits(x: seq<int>) returns (result: seq<int>)
    requires forall i :: 0 <= i < |x| ==> x[i] >= 0  // All integers in the list must be positive
    ensures forall y :: y in result ==> y in x // All elements in result are from the input list
    ensures forall a, b :: a in result && b in result && a < b ==> a < b // Result is sorted in increasing order
    ensures result == [y | y in x && no_even_digits(y)] // Result contains only elements with no even digits
    
    // Helper method to determine if a number has no even digits
    method no_even_digits(n: int) returns (has_no_even: bool)
        requires n >= 0
        ensures has_no_even <==> forall d :: d in digits(n) ==> d % 2 != 0 // Every digit is odd

    // Helper method to extract digits from a number
    method digits(n: int) returns (d: seq<int>)
        requires n >= 0
        ensures |d| > 0 ==> d[0] == n % 10 // Last digit of n
        ensures |d| == 0 <==> n == 0 // If n is 0, the digits sequence is empty
